summary: Submitted the probe the snapshot child question asks for. The harness gains a drift-then-snapshot case over the snapshot-capable entry type: it builds the three-node cluster, appends the five entries, decides the StopSign, repeats the three reconnection rounds that witness the drift, samples all nodes, then calls snapshot(Some(8), false) on the leader — an index strictly inside the drifted decided index but above the six indices of content, so try_snapshot's equal case does not apply — with the call wrapped in catch_unwind and an event reporting the outcome, the compacted index, the leader's accepted and decided indexes and how many entry ids the snapshot reachable at index 0 holds; it samples all nodes again afterwards. The comparisons require the six-index baseline before the call, that the call is accepted, that the compacted index does not pass the six indices of content, that the produced snapshot holds the five decided entries the log contained, and that every replica still reports six indices afterwards; the source prediction from the snapshot bound and the range arithmetic is that the request is accepted while the snapshot is built from an empty range, so the compacted index passes the content and the snapshot holds none of the entries. Validation passes and execution is requested; the snapshot question's interpretation still stands as source-only until this receipt, and the trim child, the drift parent, timers and loss triggers, larger clusters, persistence and any further independent lead remain incomplete.
